title: Quick Oozing Ethiopian Fenugreek Stew
description: A rich and comforting stew made with fenugreek, nuka-pickle, and a blend of spices. Perfect for a quick and satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large terracotta dish over medium heat.
Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add cumin, turmeric, and red pepper flakes and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add fenugreek greens and cook, stirring occasionally, until wilted, about 5 minutes.
Add nuka-pickle and water and bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, until the stew has thickened and the flavors have melded together, about 15 minutes.
Stir in labneh cheese and cook, uncovered, until melted and creamy, about 2 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
Let the stew rest for a few minutes to allow the flavors to settle before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
